newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Meditrust 1998 view raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Meditrust 1998 view raised.

text.p: - EVEREN Securities Inc said Tuesday it had raised its estimate for Meditrust SBI's 1998 funds from operations to $3.35 a share from $3.29. It is maintaining its 1997 estimate of $3.14.
- EVEREN cited Meditrust's definitive merger agreement with Santa Anita Cos.
-- "We base the increase on Meditrust being able to complete 1998 new investments in the range of $800 million," analyst Philip Martin said in a statement.
- EVEREN said the merger would allow Meditrust to benefit from Santa Anita's paired share structure, which permits Real Estate Investment Trusts (REITs) to both own and operate entities.
"The paired share structure has the ability to allow Meditrust a growth structure allowing future FFO growth of seven to 10 percent, and potentially higher," Martin said.
- Shares of Meditrust were unchanged at 36-1/4.
